items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: An old lady gave me that picture where I used to room. She gave me that picture. This is Bessie Smith. Bessie Smith used to room at her house.

ctx.x: Really? The famous Bessie Smith blues singer? The famous Bessie Smith when she was young. Yeah. That's Bessie Smith. I knew her, I didn't really know her. I used to go to here every chance I could in New York, you know, in the 30s.

The famous Bessie Smith picture there when she was very young, she was small, but after she started getting older she put on a lot of weight all the time. She had a picture made very frantic there. Looked like she was just coming out of the bathroom. That's Bessie Smith. That's Bessie Smith. Almost hard to believe. Not that I'm a big fan. You know what I mean? An old lady gave me that picture where I used to room. She gave me that picture. This is Bessie Smith. Bessie Smith used to room at her house.
Seen a lot of good pictures in late years of her. She was very young. She was very young.
